missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Секунда' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Каждая' agrees in the feminine, and 'важна' is the short feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Секунду' is the accusative direct object after 'подожди'. 'Одну' agrees in the feminine accusative. A very common spoken request.
Strategic focus: Genitive with negation. 'Секунды' is genitive after the negated verb with 'ни', emphasising not a single second. A natural urgency phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Секундой' is the instrumental after 'с' in the idiom meaning with each passing second. 'Каждой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О секунде' uses the prepositional after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Каждой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Секунды' is genitive after 'концу', linking the end to the second. The phrase follows 'к', a dative preposition governing 'концу'.
Strategic focus: Accusative with 'за'. 'Секунду' is the accusative after 'за' to express a span of time. 'Одну' agrees, and 'многое' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a number. 'Секунд' is the genitive plural required after 'шестьдесят'. 'В минуте' is prepositional, marking the unit.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Секунды' is the nominative plural subject of 'тянулись'. 'Последние' agrees, and 'долго' describes the slow feeling.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'несколько'. 'Секунд' is the genitive plural required after the quantifier 'несколько'. 'На' frames the small delay.
